newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca shoots up after U.S. court ruling.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca shoots up after U.S. court ruling.

text.p: Shares in Zeneca Group Plc pushed 30-1/2p higher to 18.46-1/2 stg on Friday after the pharmaceutical group said a U.S. court had dismissed a challenge to its U.S. patent for tamoxifen citrate.

The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit Court dismissed a challenge by the Canadian drugs company Novopharm Limited to the patent for the drug, marketed as "Novadex" -- the mostly widely used medicine for the treatment of breast cancer.
"Novadex is quite an important product for Zeneca and this court case has been dragging on for sometime," one market maker said. "Hopefully the patent challenge by Novopharm will now stop."

Last week, Novopharm, a privately-held company based in Scarborough, Ontario, won the right to market a generic version of Glaxo Wellcome Plc's popular ulcer drug Zantac, the world's best selling prescription medication.
